lead: Oxnard plumbing deals with hard water, salt air and slab homes. PipeMend sends licensed local plumbers across Oxnard.
risk: slab leaks, hard water scale and salt-air corrosion
risk_short: slab leaks, hard water and corrosion
why: Central Oxnard and La Colonia have homes from the 1920s to the 1960s with galvanized supply lines and cast-iron drains. Most other areas were built from the 1960s on, on slabs.
Salt air near Oxnard Shores, Mandalay Bay and the harbor corrodes outdoor fittings and water heater parts. California requires water heaters to be strapped for earthquakes.
water: Oxnard blends imported water, local groundwater treated at its desalter and highly treated recycled water. It is hard.
tips: Strap your water heater for earthquakes.
Rinse and check outdoor fittings for corrosion.
Watch your water bill for slab leak signs.
areas: PipeMend works Downtown and in Oxnard Shores, Mandalay Bay, Silver Strand, Channel Islands Harbor, La Colonia, RiverPark and every other neighborhood.
permits: Plumbing permits come from the City of Oxnard Development Services, and plumbing contractors need a CSLB license with a C-36 classification.

faq.a: Yes. Local groundwater and imported water both carry minerals. Scale builds up in water heaters and on fixtures, so many homes use softeners.
